patch_meta.name: BMU Hub — Actions Architecture (Create · Edit · Assign · Reassign · Move · Archive)
patch_meta.merge_instruction: Merge into BMU_Hub_Architecture_Prompt.json as top-level key 'actions'. Where this conflicts with v1.0, this patch wins. Do not change any other section.

global_action_system.principle: Anything a user can see, a permitted user can add, edit, assign, reassign, move, duplicate, archive or restore — from wherever they are, without leaving the screen.

entry_points.global_new_button: Persistent '+ New' button in top bar (web) and floating button (mobile). Menu is filtered by the user's permissions and shows: Person, Client, Lead, Task, Request, Engagement, Invoice, File upload, Creator, Note, Meeting, Announcement.
entry_points.command_palette: Ctrl/Cmd + K on web: search any record or type an action ('new task for Aroma', 'reassign Reel 03 to Arjun', 'add user to Design').
entry_points.contextual_add: Inline '+ Add' inside every list, board column, calendar day, hierarchy node, client 360 tab and thread. Context is pre-filled (e.g. adding a task inside a client pre-fills client + engagement).
entry_points.row_actions: Every row/card has a '⋯' menu: Edit, Assign/Reassign, Change deadline, Move, Duplicate, Archive, View history.
entry_points.drag_and_drop: Board columns (change status/phase), hierarchy tree (change manager/team), calendar (change date), capacity view (reassign to another person).
entry_points.bulk_actions: Multi-select in any list: reassign, change status, change deadline, add tag, archive, export.
entry_points.import: CSV/Excel import for people, clients, leads, tasks, creators with column mapping, validation preview and duplicate check.
entry_points.quick_add_mobile: Long-press floating button: Task, Note, Photo/Video upload, Request (client), Blocked report.

form_pattern.layout: Side drawer on web, full-screen sheet on mobile. Required fields first; optional fields collapsed under 'More details'.
form_pattern.validation: Inline, on blur and on save; server re-validates.
form_pattern.duplicate_detection: On person/client/lead/creator create: match on phone, email, GSTIN, business name; show 'Possible duplicate' with Merge or Continue.
form_pattern.autosave_drafts: Forms with more than 5 fields autosave drafts every 10 seconds.

record_lifecycle.archive: Default for removal; hidden from lists, kept for reports and audit; restorable.
record_lifecycle.delete: Only Founder/Admin; only records with no financial or approval history; 30-day trash then purge.
record_lifecycle.undo: Toast with Undo for 10 seconds after edit, move, reassign, archive and bulk actions.

global_action_system.history: Every record has a 'History' tab: who changed what, from → to, when, reason. Written to AuditEvent.
global_action_system.permission_check: Every action checks role + scope on the server. Buttons the user cannot use are hidden; buttons blocked by a gate are shown disabled with the reason on hover/tap.

sensitive_action_approval.rule: Actions marked approval_required create an ApprovalRequest; the change applies only after approval.
sensitive_action_approval.approver: Next rank up in hierarchy, unless specified
sensitive_action_approval.where: Approver sees it in 'Needs you' and Admin Panel → Approvals queue

global_action_system.reason_required: Reassign, deadline change, archive, price override, role change and offboarding require a short reason (dropdown + optional note).

flow: Pick new owner: list filtered to eligible roles + department, showing current load %, leave status, active tasks and skills
System shows impact: deadlines at risk, dependencies, client-facing dates
Choose deadline handling: keep / extend by N working days / set new
Add handover note (required for in-progress work) and reason
Confirm → ownership moves; full history, files, comments and time logs stay on the record
rules: Cannot assign to a user on approved leave for the deadline date (override needs Department Head).
Assigning above 100% capacity shows a warning; above 120% needs Department Head approval.
Reassigning a client's CM requires CM Lead or Admin, and the client is notified with the new CM's intro.
Client-facing deadline changes caused by reassignment require CM confirmation and a client update in thread.
Previous owner keeps read access for 7 days for handover questions.
Reassign reasons: leave, overload, skill fit, quality issue, priority change, offboarding, client request, other.

auto_reassign.on_leave_approved: Tasks due during leave are suggested for reassignment to the Department Head 2 working days before leave starts.
auto_reassign.on_offboarding: All open records must be reassigned before offboarding can complete (blocking checklist).
auto_reassign.on_overdue_unacknowledged: Task not started 1 working day before deadline → Department Head alert with one-tap reassign.

reassignment_engine.bulk_reassign: Admin/Department Head can move all open work from Person A to Person B (or split across several) with preview.
notify: client only if CM or client-facing date changes

organisation_hierarchy.name: Add person to team
flow: Open from + New → Person, or '+ Add' on any hierarchy node (pre-fills department/manager)
Fill details, choose role(s) and permissions preview
Select onboarding checklist (laptop, accounts, SOP reading, shadowing)
Send invite (SMS + email) → user sets password/OTP and 2FA
organisation_hierarchy.approval: Department Head-initiated adds need Admin approval
notify: access scoped by role + manager chain
staff onboarding tasks created for HR and manager

organisation_hierarchy.name: Edit person
rules: Role, department and manager changes go through change_role / move_person

organisation_hierarchy.name: Change manager / team / department / branch
flow: Drag node on hierarchy tree or use Move
Choose what happens to open work: keep / reassign via reassignment_engine
notify: visibility recalculated immediately on effective date

organisation_hierarchy.name: Promote / change role / add secondary role
organisation_hierarchy.approval: Must be done by someone at least one rank above the new role; Founder for Admin role

organisation_hierarchy.name: Create department, team/pod or branch
flow: Attach default flow templates and QC checklists (department)

organisation_hierarchy.name: Create client pod
system_effects: clients' new tasks default to pod members

organisation_hierarchy.name: Apply / approve leave
flow: Manager sees open tasks during leave and approves

organisation_hierarchy.name: Offboard team member
flow: Blocking checklist: reassign all open tasks, clients, leads, requests, approvals; return assets; revoke vault access; transfer file ownership
notify: login disabled at end of last day
person removed from tree, shown under 'Former'

leads_sales.name: Add lead
flow: + New → Lead / pipeline column '+ Add' / auto from website, ad forms, BMU QR

leads_sales.name: Create proposal
flow: Discount within limit or request approval
leads_sales.approval: Discount above role limit → Sales Manager; above Sales Manager limit → Founder

leads_sales.name: Revise proposal
rules: Creates new version; old link shows 'Superseded'

leads_sales.name: Convert lead to client
flow: Triggered by proposal payment, or manual with payment proof
Runs add_client with data from lead + proposal

clients.name: Add new client
flow: Entry: + New → Client, Clients list '+ Add', lead conversion, or CSV import
Add engagements (services + tiers) or skip to add later
Assign CM (auto-suggest by load and industry) → handover form
Choose: invite client users now / later
Choose start mode: new onboarding or 'existing client migration' (skips sales steps, lets CM set current gate with reason)
clients.approval: Manual client without online payment needs Finance to confirm payment received
notify: welcome message sent when users invited
rules: Existing-client migration: import past files and invoices; mark historical approvals as 'migrated'

clients.name: Edit client details
allowed_roles: client_owner (own contact + billing info, CM notified)

clients.name: Invite client user
rules: CM-invited Owner role needs existing Owner or Admin confirmation

clients.name: Assign / reassign Client Manager
flow: Old CM writes handover note (open requests, client preferences, pending approvals)
Client receives intro of new CM in thread

clients.name: Add service to existing client
flow: Client 360 → Services → '+ Add service', or client taps 'Add service' in app
New onboarding checklist for that service only

clients.name: Upgrade / downgrade tier
flow: Applies from next cycle (upgrade can apply mid-cycle with pro-rata)
clients.approval: Client Owner; downgrade also notifies CM Lead

clients.name: Cancel engagement / offboard client
flow: Checklist: dues cleared, final files, access removal, permissions, final report, pending work, contract closure
notify: client users set read-only for 90 days, then archived

tasks_work.name: Add new task
flow: Entry: + New → Task, '+ Add' in board column/list/calendar day/client 360/deliverable, convert from message or comment, quick add on mobile
Optional: description, brief, references, checklist, subtasks, dependencies, estimate, attachments, linked deliverable, watchers
Assignee picker shows load % and leave
system_effects: task appears in assignee's My Day on start date
rules: Client tasks must link to an engagement in Gate 3 or later, or be marked 'pre-production' (planning/onboarding).
A task that adds client deliverables beyond scope must link to an approved add-on request; otherwise saved as draft and CM is alerted.
Producers can assign tasks only to themselves or create subtasks; assigning to others needs Department Head / CM / Strategist.
Internal tasks (training, admin, pitches) allowed with no client.

tasks_work.name: Add tasks from flow template
flow: Set start date; durations computed in working days

tasks_work.name: Create recurring task
required_fields: repeat rule (daily, weekly, monthly, cycle start)
rules: Instances generated 7 days ahead; skip Sundays/holidays

tasks_work.name: Add subtask / dependency
rules: Parent can't move to Done while subtasks are open
Dependent task shows 'Waiting' until predecessor is Done

tasks_work.name: Change deadline
rules: Producers can request, not change
If client-facing date moves, CM must post update in client thread
Changes counted in delivery reports

tasks_work.name: Update status
rules: Blocked requires reason, waiting for, responsible, date requested, expected resolution
Done on deliverable tasks routes to QC, not directly to client

tasks_work.name: Add deliverable to plan/calendar
rules: After Gate 2 the plan is locked: new deliverables need an add-on request or a scope swap approved by client

requests_approvals.name: Create add-on quote
required_fields: items from add-on list or custom

requests_approvals.name: Convert approved request to tasks
flow: One tap after approval + payment; uses template if matched

finance.name: Create manual invoice
rules: Pass-through items (ad spend, creator fees) on separate lines

finance.name: Record offline payment (bank transfer, cheque, cash)

creators.name: Add creator
rules: Duplicate check on phone and handle

files_content.name: Upload files
rules: Client uploads land in 'From client' and tick matching requirement items when tagged

files_content.name: Release final files to client
rules: Only after Gate 5

communication.name: Convert message or comment into task / request
flow: '⋯' on message → Create task / Create request

communication.name: Send announcement
required_fields: audience (all clients, segment, all team, department)

admin_configuration.name: Add / edit service, tier, bundle, add-on
rules: Creates new price book version

admin_configuration.name: Add / edit SOP, checklist, flow template, QC checklist
rules: Versioned; running cycles keep old version unless CM opts in

admin_configuration.name: Add holiday / change working hours
rules: Recalculates SLA timers and working-day deadlines

admin_configuration.name: Add / edit notification template
rules: WhatsApp templates require Meta approval status before use

admin_configuration.name: Connect / disconnect integration
rules: Per-client ad/social accounts connected by CM with client consent

approval_matrix.approver: blocked until add-on approved by client

hierarchy_tree: '+ Add person' and '+ Add team' on each node
click node → profile drawer with Reassign work / Change role / Offboard
capacity_view: drag task between people to reassign
board: '+ Add' at top of each column
drag between columns respects gates (blocked moves bounce back with reason)
ui_requirements.empty_states: Every empty list shows the primary add action, e.g. 'No clients yet — Add client'.
ui_requirements.mobile: Floating '+' on every tab; swipe on a task card: right = update status, left = reassign/deadline.
ui_requirements.design_authority: Use components and tokens from uploaded UX/UI designs; where no design exists for a form or drawer, build from existing design components and flag it.

api_conventions.pattern: REST: POST /{entity} (create), PATCH /{entity}/{id} (edit), POST /{entity}/{id}/assign, POST /{entity}/{id}/reassign, POST /{entity}/{id}/move, POST /{entity}/{id}/archive, POST /{entity}/{id}/restore, POST /{entity}/bulk, POST /imports/{entity}
every_mutation: creates ApprovalRequest if required instead of applying
returns updated record + undo token where applicable

acceptance_criteria_additions: Every entity in data_model can be created from '+ New', from its list and from at least one contextual location.
A permitted user can add a person anywhere in the hierarchy tree in under 60 seconds.
A new client can be added manually (no lead) and as a migrated existing client with current gate set.
Any task can be created, assigned, reassigned, re-dated and archived from web and mobile.
Reassignment preserves comments, files, time logs and history and notifies new owner, old owner and manager.
Offboarding a person is impossible while they own any open record.
Bulk reassign of all open work from one person to another works with preview and undo.
Producers cannot assign work to other people or change deadlines; they can only request.
Out-of-scope client tasks cannot go active without an approved add-on.
Every create/edit/assign/reassign/archive appears in the record's History tab and in the audit log.
